project_info.color_palette: Warm off-white, moss green, brown amber, muted olive shadow

main_subject.detail: A minimalist square flat-lay composition featuring the left half of a white summer short partially cropped into the frame, paired with amber-brown sunglasses near the top-left area. The design is split diagonally between a clean off-white paper-like surface and a mossy green grass texture, with oversized typography dominating the lower-right side.
main_subject.style: Clean seasonal fashion teaser, premium resort flat-lay, minimal advertising graphic, airy summer lifestyle aesthetic

items: Left Edge: a white short cropped into the frame, showing the waistband, side seam, and hem in a clean product partial view.
Upper Left: amber-brown acetate sunglasses placed diagonally over the off-white area, casting a soft shadow.
Center to Right: the background is split by a sharp diagonal edge between the off-white surface on the left and textured green grass on the right.
Top Area: soft diagonal palm-shadow stripes cross the off-white surface, creating a resort sunlight feel.
Lower Right: huge white uppercase typography reading 'SUMMER' above 'SHORT', spanning across both background zones.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft tropical daylight, palm-shadow projection, subtle object shadows, relaxed resort atmosphere, clean high-key finish

technical_specs.render_style: Photorealistic fashion flat-lay poster with minimal graphic typography

prompt_instructions: If using gpt-image-2, attach the original image or product reference so the short silhouette and exact crop remain close to the source.
Keep the design minimal and seasonal; do not add extra props beyond the sunglasses.
Preserve the sharp diagonal split between off-white surface and green grass, and keep the oversized text exactly as 'SUMMER SHORT'.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square seasonal fashion poster for a minimal summer short campaign. Create a clean flat-lay composition with the left side on an off-white paper-like surface and the right side on textured green grass, separated by a sharp diagonal edge. Place a white summer short partially cropped along the left edge so the waistband, hem, and side seam are visible. Add amber-brown sunglasses near the upper-left area, angled casually with a soft shadow. Across the top left surface, project soft diagonal palm-leaf shadows to suggest tropical daylight. On the lower-right half, add huge white uppercase typography reading 'SUMMER' above 'SHORT', spanning across the diagonal split. Style should feel premium, airy, resort-inspired, and minimal. Technical style: photorealistic fashion flat-lay poster with minimal graphic typography, warm natural sunlight, soft tropical daylight, subtle shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
